summary: Local Bounti Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Convertible Note and Warrant Purchase Agreement with U.S. Bounti, LLC. The agreement provides for a $12.5 million convertible note (7.0% PIK interest) and a warrant to purchase 1,000,000 common shares. The note converts at $1.37 per share, with 50% automatic conversion on the fourth anniversary. Proceeds fund working capital. This is a financing arrangement, not a classic special situation, though the convertible note with PIK interest and warrant suggests potential dilution. Watch for conversion activity and balance-sheet impact.
